verdict.rationale: CoreWeave offers CKS as managed Kubernetes on bare metal with autoscaling node pools, and SUNK lets platform engineers run managed Slurm jobs inside that same Kubernetes cluster, directly delivering scheduling without building custom schedulers on raw nodes. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Slurm-on-K8s (SUNK) at scale beyond CoreWeave's own docs, and details on job-queue features (priorities, preemption) comparable to a full HPC scheduler.
